title: Uniform convergence of difference quotients of a C^1 map on compact sets
statement: Let n be a natural number, E : Type (universe 0) a real normed space, U ⊆ R^n open, f : R^n -> E of class C^1 on U, K ⊆ U compact and e in R^n. Then h^{-1}(f(x + he) - f(x)) -> Df(x)e = fderiv R f x e uniformly for x in K as h -> 0 with h ≠ 0 (TendstoUniformlyOn along the filter 𝓝[≠] 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : Rn n → E) (U K : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (h : ℝ) (x : Rn n) => h⁻¹ • (f (x + h • e) - f x)) (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x e) (𝓝[≠] 0) K
